headline: 电影剧集双线爆款，暑期档尾声热度不减
headlineEn: Movies and Series Stay Hot as Summer Ends
summary: 今日无新片上映，本周有8部新电影登场。电影方面《最后的曙光》强势领跑；剧集方面《侠探杰克》热度登顶，IP双线发酵。同期《绿灯军团》等科幻题材持续升温，暑期档尾声热度不减。
summaryEn: No new films opened today, while eight new movies landed this week. 'The Last Dawn' leads the film charts, and 'Reacher' tops TV heat, with IP synergy in full swing. Sci-fi titles like 'Green Lantern Corps' keep rising as late summer heats up.

industryHighlights.text: 今日电影市场零新片上映，观影需求转向存量热片。
industryHighlights.en: No new films hit theaters today, with demand shifting to existing hits.

industryHighlights.text: 本周共有8部新电影集中上映，暑期档尾声竞争激烈。
industryHighlights.en: Eight new movies opened this week, intensifying the late-summer box office race.

industryHighlights.text: 《侠探杰克》同时占据电影与剧集热度榜，IP双线联动效应显著。
industryHighlights.en: With 'Reacher' trending in both film and TV charts, the IP's dual-platform synergy is evident.

industryHighlights.text: 《绿灯军团》跨界上榜，科幻宇宙题材持续受关注。
industryHighlights.en: 'Green Lantern Corps' appears across charts, keeping sci-fi universe titles in the spotlight.

industryHighlights.text: 未来暂无新片定档，市场将依赖当前热作延续热度。
industryHighlights.en: No notable upcoming releases are scheduled, leaving current hits to sustain momentum.
